name: SoundCrowd
tagline: Play music from many services in one simple app
description:
SoundCrowd is a music player that pulls songs together from several places, including SoundCloud, YouTube, Spotify, Beatport, and Tidal, so you don't need a different app for each one. It can also listen to a song playing nearby and tell you what it is, much like Shazam.

You'll also see a visual waveform of your tracks, making it easy to see where you are in a song at a glance.
